gist: Moscow stock ledger (upper part). Issue I: 78 copies in the Kontora on 1 Dec 1893; 18 issued to subscribers of issue III at 2 р. 50 к.; 2 to the Губернская типографія at 10% discount (2 р. 25 к.); 58 remain. Issue II: 250 in the Kontora + 30 at the Губернская типографія = 280; issued 24 to subscribers at 3 р., 9 sold via the типографія at 3 р. 60 к., 21 to subscribers at 2 р. 70 к. (prices read from enhanced image; verify).
why: stock counts and per-copy prices/discounts for issues I–II

gist: Lower part of the same ledger (overlaps p.6). Issue II: 54 issued, 226 remain of 280. Issue III: 288 received (отношеніе of 19 Feb № 430); 266 issued to subscribers at 2 р. 50 к., 9 sold at 4 р.; 275 out, 13 remain. Signed by the Дѣлопроизводитель of the Moscow Kontora.
why: stock counts and prices for issues II–III

gist: Right-hand strip of the same ledger: money column with sums 161.10 and 701 [руб.] against the issue II and III outgoings; end of the signature line '... Императорскихъ театровъ' + signature.
